Fit the joint SuSiE-OUT nuisance model from a low-rank genotype reference

Source: R/factorized_fit.R
susieout_fit_nuisance_grid_factorized.Rd

This is an exact computational backend for LD matrices constructed from a finite reference panel. It uses a single thin singular-value decomposition of the reference genotypes while fitting the same null, tested-variant, OUT, infinitesimal, and LD-mismatch states as susieout_fit_nuisance_grid().

Usage

susieout_fit_nuisance_grid_factorized(
  z,
  n,
  examined_genotypes,
  outside_genotypes,
  examined_ids = NULL,
  excluded_ids = NULL,
  effect_prior = "robust_mixture",
  L = 10L,
  count_prior = susieout_count_prior(),
  nuisance_prior,
  trained_prior = NULL,
  ridge = 1e-06,
  max_iter = 200L,
  tol = 1e-05
)

Arguments

z, n, examined_ids, effect_prior, L, count_prior, trained_prior

Arguments analogous to susieout_fit_nuisance_grid().

examined_genotypes

Reference dosage matrix for tested variants, with samples in rows.

outside_genotypes

Reference dosage matrix for omitted variants, with the same samples and ordering.

excluded_ids

IDs for columns of outside_genotypes.

nuisance_prior

Frozen grid prior from susieout_train_nuisance_grid().

ridge, max_iter, tol

Numerical controls.

Value

An susieout_fit averaged over the learned joint nuisance grid.
